title: 12 Best Rendang in Padang 2026
description: The best rendang in Padang, Indonesia — where the dish was born. From Restoran Selamat's legendary 100kg-a-day rendang to wood-fired Randang Rajo Rajo. Interactive map included.

places.name: Restoran Selamat
places.whatToOrder: The rendang daging sapi — their signature since 1953. It's dark, almost black, with a slightly wet texture that distinguishes it from drier rendang elsewhere. Pair with steamed white rice and their gulai nangka (jackfruit curry). Come early — they sell out 80–100 kg of rendang daily, often by early afternoon.

redditQuotes.text: Kalo bagi saya orang asli Kota Padang, kalo the best bagi kami Rendang Restoran Selamat." (As a native Padang local, the best rendang for us is Restoran Selamat.)
redditQuotes.source: — TikTok comment from local ·3 Rendang Recommendations in Padang, Feb 2025

redditQuotes.text: Restoran Selamat has been around since 1953 and processes 80 to 100 kg of rendang daily — which often sells out within hours.

places.insiderTip: The undisputed rendang king of Padang. 70+ years in business, located right at Pasar Raya (the city's central market), and their dark, slightly wet rendang has a depth of flavor you won't find anywhere else. The fact that locals — not tourists — call this the best says everything. Arrive before noon or risk heartbreak.

places.name: Rumah Makan Lamun Ombak
places.whatToOrder: The rendang daging sapi hitam — black rendang that's deeply caramelized. Also try their ayam pop (steamed fried chicken unique to Padang), dendeng balado (crispy beef with chili), and telur barendo. Multiple branches across Padang — the Khatib Sulaiman location is the most popular.

redditQuotes.text: Black colored rendang is the best, and Lamun Ombak's Rendang is precisely like that, black and delicious. Also my favorite is the minced meat with balado sambal.
redditQuotes.source: — TripAdvisor review ·Best Padang food in Padang

redditQuotes.text: I tried Lamun Ombak in Padang, way better than 95% of the so-called Padang restaurants elsewhere.

places.insiderTip: The #1 restaurant in Padang on TripAdvisor with 350+ reviews. It's where politicians, celebrities, and visiting dignitaries eat — reportedly inspiring the viral "Nasi Padang" song. More polished and tourist-friendly than Selamat, with spacious air-conditioned seating and an overwhelming spread of dishes. The full nasi Padang experience at its finest.

places.name: Restoran Sari Raso
places.whatToOrder: The rendang — known for having the most "nendang" (punchy, impactful) flavor in Padang. Their ayam goreng (fried chicken) is equally legendary, with a crispy skin that's become a benchmark. The restaurant is spacious and great for families.

redditQuotes.text: We ventured to Sari Reso for a great authentic Indonesian meal. Eating rendang is a 'hands-on experience', and it is the traditional way to enjoy the dish.
redditQuotes.source: — Nicole Isaacs ·Finding the Best Rendang in Padang

redditQuotes.text: Restoran Sari Raso is known as one of the restaurants offering the most 'nendang' rendang in Padang — bold, strong spice character that deeply penetrates the meat.

places.insiderTip: Rated 4.3/5 on TripAdvisor (#12 in Padang) and a firm local favorite. Sari Raso's rendang has a bolder spice profile than the competition — more aggressive with chili and galangal. Their fried chicken is also exceptional. A solid all-rounder that's particularly good for a first-timer's nasi Padang experience.

places.name: Rumah Makan Pagi Sore
places.whatToOrder: The rendang and their gulai otak (brain curry) — a Minangkabau delicacy. Pagi Sore is listed on TasteAtlas as one of the best places for rendang globally. Their original Padang branch is the flagship — the Jakarta locations are good but not quite the same.

redditQuotes.text: Pagi Sore… This is the ultimate Padang food in Indonesia. Padang food is very famous dish in South East Asia most specifically in Indonesia.
I didn't try the rendang but Rumah Makan Padang Pagi Sore in Pekanbaru — absolute beast. The best nasi padang in my life.
redditQuotes.source: — r/indonesia ·Where did you find the best rendang?

places.insiderTip: A TasteAtlas-recognized institution. Pagi Sore has expanded to Jakarta and beyond, but the Padang original on Jl. Pondok still hits different. The rendang here leans slightly more traditional — medium-dark, with a balanced coconut-spice ratio. A safe, excellent choice if you want the classic Padang dining experience with reliable quality.

places.name: Rendang Asese
places.whatToOrder: The rendang daging sapi — this is a rendang specialist, not a full restaurant. They also sell packaged rendang (SNI-certified, Halal, HACCP) for takeaway, making it perfect for bringing rendang home as oleh-oleh (souvenirs). Operating since 2003.

redditQuotes.text: Rendang Asese is mentioned as one of the places with the tastiest rendang in Padang, attracting attention from food lovers across the region.
Rendang Asese is a well-known spot in Padang, famous for delicious rendang that appeals to both locals and visitors alike.

places.insiderTip: The only SNI-certified rendang producer on this list — meaning their rendang meets Indonesia's national food safety standards. This is both a dine-in spot and a rendang shop, perfect for buying vacuum-packed rendang as gifts. The quality is consistent and reliable, if slightly less "artisanal" than the old-school rumah makan. Great for souvenir hunters.

places.name: Rumah Makan Saiyo Sakato
places.whatToOrder: Rendang with nasi putih, ayam bakar (grilled chicken), and ayam serundeng (chicken with toasted coconut). Being 24 hours means you can satisfy a midnight rendang craving — rare for Padang restaurants. Branches in Jakarta and Surabaya too.

redditQuotes.text: Saiyo Sakato offers a consistent selection of Padang dishes with rich traditional spices. Their rendang is one of the reliable staples, prepared with authentic Minangkabau flavors.

places.insiderTip: The 24-hour option. While not the most famous for rendang specifically, Saiyo Sakato delivers solid, consistent Padang food around the clock. Perfect for late arrivals at Minangkabau Airport or anyone who needs rendang at 2 AM. Their expansion to Jakarta and Surabaya proves the quality travels.

places.name: Randang Rajo Rajo
places.whatToOrder: The rendang daging — cooked for 7 full hours over kayu bakar (wood fire), which gives the meat an incomparably deep, smoky tenderness. Also known as "Rumah Makan Simpang Jondul" by locals due to its strategic junction location.

redditQuotes.text: The rendang is very special because it's cooked for seven hours, resulting in extremely tender meat. The strong aroma from wood-fire cooking adds to the uniqueness.

places.insiderTip: This is rendang the way your Minang grandmother makes it — cooked for 7 hours over real wood fire. No shortcuts, no gas stoves. The result is fall-apart tender meat with a smoky depth that commercial restaurants can't replicate. A hidden gem at a junction in Rawang that most tourists will never find. Worth the trek.

places.name: Rumah Makan Ampalu Raya
places.address: Jl. Jhoni Anwar, Ulak Karang Utara
places.whatToOrder: The rendang — Ampalu Raya consistently ranks among Padang's best for authentic Minangkabau flavor. Pair with their gulai itik (duck curry) and sambal hijau (green chili sambal) for the full experience. Open 7 AM to 9:30 PM.

redditQuotes.text: Ampalu Raya is included in the list of rumah makan with the tastiest rendang in Padang. The authentic Minangkabau flavor is the main attraction.

places.insiderTip: A neighborhood favorite in Ulak Karang that doesn't chase tourist attention. Ampalu Raya does honest, no-frills Padang food with rendang that punches well above its price point. The early opening (7 AM) means you can grab rendang for breakfast — very Padang.

places.name: Rumah Makan Sederhana
places.whatToOrder: Rendang daging sapi with nasi putih, sambal balado, and gulai ayam. Sederhana is the most ubiquitous Padang restaurant chain in Indonesia — with hundreds of branches nationwide — but the original Padang location maintains a higher standard than the franchises.

redditQuotes.text: Restoran Padang Sederhana is a chain Padang restaurant. If you're craving nasi Padang with rendang, it's a solid reliable choice — you know what you're getting.
Padang Merdeka: Telur dadar crispy the best — but for rendang, Pagi Sore and Sederhana are better.

places.insiderTip: The McDonald's of Padang food — and we mean that as a compliment. Sederhana standardized nasi Padang across Indonesia, and their Padang flagship is noticeably better than the franchise outposts. It won't blow your mind like Selamat, but it's consistent, clean, and affordable. The safe choice.

places.name: Rumah Makan Surya
places.whatToOrder: Their rendang hitam — dark, intensely black rendang that's been cooked down completely. RM Surya is known for having some of the darkest rendang in the city, achieved through extended cooking with pure coconut milk over fire.

redditQuotes.text: RM Surya is one of the warung nasi Padang known for having rendang hitam pekat — deep, dark black rendang cooked until all moisture is absorbed.
redditQuotes.source: — Detik Food ·5 Warung with Darkest Rendang

places.insiderTip: For rendang purists who believe darker = better (and in Padang, they're right). RM Surya's rendang hitam represents the old-school Minangkabau standard — cooked until every drop of coconut milk has been absorbed into the meat. Not a fancy restaurant, just great rendang at honest prices.

places.name: Rumah Makan Talago Baru
places.whatToOrder: Rendang, dendeng bakar (grilled jerky), kalii hati (liver curry), and ikan gulai (fish curry). The Padang original has expanded to a massive chain across Jakarta and beyond — a testament to the quality of their food.

redditQuotes.text: Rumah Makan Talago Baru Kota Padang — rendang paling nikmat di kota Padang! Two portions of rendang, dendeng bakar, kalii hati, and ikan — all incredible.
redditQuotes.source: — YouTube review ·Most Delicious Rendang in Padang

places.insiderTip: Talago Baru has grown from a single Padang rumah makan into a national chain — which can be a red flag, but the Padang flagship maintains quality. Their rendang sits in the sweet spot between wet kalio and fully dry rendang. Pair with their dendeng bakar for a satisfying contrast of textures.

places.name: Ampera Padi Rimbun
places.whatToOrder: The rendang — they process up to 100 kg daily, rivaling Restoran Selamat's volume. Despite the industrial scale, the quality remains high. Also excellent for their gulai tunjang (tendons in curry) and sambal balado ijo.

redditQuotes.text: Ampera Padi Rimbun is the 'giant' of rendang production in Padang. They process up to 100 kg of beef daily — and it still sells out.
redditQuotes.source: — Pikiran Rakyat ·7 Best Rendang in Padang

places.insiderTip: Volume doesn't always mean quality — but at Padi Rimbun, it does. Moving 100 kg of rendang daily means constant turnover, which means your rendang was made that morning, not sitting around. A workhorse of Padang's rendang scene that delivers consistent quality at very fair prices.
